l5_ecog3_meaning.quote: Intensive salvage chemotherapy, a second CAR-T, allogeneic transplant and most clinical trials are not realistic options at ECOG 3
l5_ecog3_meaning.note: Explains limits well but gives no prognosis estimate (months).

l5_capacity.quote: confirm his understanding and his goals (home, family, comfort)
l5_capacity.note: Checks understanding but never explicitly assesses/confirms decision-making capacity after ICANS.

l5_respect_refusal_goc.quote: I would respect his decision, document it clearly, and proceed with a comfort-focused plan

l5_hospice_palliative.quote: consider palliative radiation to the painful liver or retroperitoneal disease, or a thoracentesis for symptomatic pleural effusion

l5_advance_directive.quote: complete advance care planning including a health care proxy, code status/DNR-DNI and a POLST if appropriate

l5_financial_social_work.quote: I would involve social work and a financial navigator immediately

l5_caregiver_support.quote: I would connect the wife to respite care, caregiver support and counseling for exhaustion

l5_mn_pressure_treatment.quote: rather than trying to persuade him to continue anticancer therapy

l5_mn_abandon.quote: give the family a clear plan for after-hours symptoms
